segments.name: Bladder Cancer
segments.description: Develops cretostimogene, its only product candidate, for high-risk and intermediate-risk NMIBC patients with bladder cancer.
segments.evidence: We currently depend entirely on the success of cretostimogene, which is our only product candidate.

revenueModel.text: It collects license, collaboration and development revenue from collaborators such as Kissei for licensing rights and milestones.
revenueModel.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2021, the Company recognized milestone revenue of $ 10 million for cash consideration received associated with an achieved development milestone and $ 0.4 million in development income related to the Kissei License Agreement.
